messages:
Tess: Quick ping 1: tapas crawl + tiny picnic on the plaza this Tuesday after 5? Casual, bring a blanket if you want to sit. :plate_with_cutlery:
Arun: Sounds great. I can do 5:30.
Maya: 5:30 works for me too. Any allergy notes?
Tess: Good Q 1: I'll check vendors for nuts and gluten-free options.
Jon: I can bring a small speaker and some reusable cups.
Tess: ops-bot can we reserve a couple of picnic benches or is plaza first-come?
ops-bot: Plaza seating is first-come. For groups >12, Facilities recommends a request: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
Arun: Let's cap at 12 then and do a waitlist if needed.
Maya: Poll: "Tapas + Trivia" vs "Just eating"  react :taco: or :fork_and_knife:
Tess: I'll post the RSVP list and pin vendor notes. Meet lobby 5:20 to walk over?
Jon: Perfect. See you Tuesday! :sun_with_face:
